summary: Round 2: all eight fix_tasks closed; contract-check ok under amended limits; M3/M5/M8/M9 killed at unit and e2e level; no real sleeps, no new panic path, IPC socket never opened.
notes: contract-check ok=true (limits amended by the orchestrator to max_diff_lines 4600, src 1350, tests 3250; real diff 4323 = src 1245 + tests 3078; 11 files = max_files_changed); not_checked: forbid.behaviors (reviewed by hand below).

Validation evidence: verify-b2.log at bc67809 shows FMT=0 CLIPPY=0 TEST=0 (reemparejamiento 16 passed, ciclo_de_vida 23, almacen 16). WARNING: 05-validation.json on disk (01:31) predates the fix commit bc67809 (01:53) and keeps the 00:00:00Z placeholder; refresh it with /q-verify before /q-accept.

Fix-task closure: (1) inyectar-plazos: PLAZOS_DE_PRUEBA (cadencia 1 ms) injected in every reemparejamiento.rs test by calling ejecutar_reemparejamiento directly; ejecutar_con_efectos signature untouched; plazos_de_rebind() now used; misleading comment fixed. (2) retry/motivo scenarios present at unit (ciclo_de_vida.rs) and sequence (reemparejamiento.rs) level. (3) resume_con_codigo_de_vinculacion_nombra_el_metodo_elegido_no_el_ecoado asserts the exact wget Cmd with --post-data {"metodo":"codigo_de_vinculacion"} and the exact stdout line. (4) pausa_fallida_en_el_paso_3 (row absent, exigir_silencio) and cierre_fallido e2e (diagnostic line + Exito). (5) confirmar_reemparejamiento_revierte_si_falla_la_insercion_en_sustituciones drops the table on a second connection. (6) unreachable!() at the transition arm replaced by a diagnosed Fallo; solicitar_emparejamiento narrowed to DesenlaceDeSolicitudDeEmparejamiento {Codigo, CanalSinSesion} so the dead Ok(Fallido) arm is gone by type; pairing line prints metodo.nombre_de_cable(). (7) 04-implementation-log.yaml lists 8 mutations with the test that went red. (8) contract limits amended by the orchestrator, no test trimmed.

Mutations re-applied in a scratch worktree at bc67809 (each sed/python edit verified non-empty by git diff): M3 persist Reemparejando before the pausar probe -> RED pausa_fallida_en_el_paso_3_no_persiste_ni_hace_nada_destructivo (reemparejamiento.rs:1272); M5 always {"metodo":"qr"} -> RED solicitar_emparejamiento_reintenta_sin_conexion_y_envia_el_metodo_elegido (ciclo_de_vida.rs:1069) and resume_con_codigo_de_vinculacion_nombra_el_metodo_elegido_no_el_ecoado; M8 reanudar fallido as success -> RED reanudar_envio_falla_si_la_respuesta_es_fallido (ciclo_de_vida.rs:1160) and resume_con_reanudar_fallido_deja_la_fila_reemparejando_y_sin_sustituciones; M9 retry on any motivo -> RED solicitar_emparejamiento_no_reintenta_con_otro_motivo (ciclo_de_vida.rs:1118) and resume_con_emparejamiento_fallido_por_otro_motivo_no_reintenta_ni_persiste. No surviving mutation.

Spot-checked 2 logged mutations: ignoring the sustituciones INSERT error -> RED confirmar_reemparejamiento_revierte_si_falla_la_insercion_en_sustituciones (almacen_plano_de_control.rs:439); step-7 guard inverted (== -> !=) -> RED descartar_sqlstore_y_rearrancar_reintenta_la_pausa_tras_sin_conexion (ciclo_de_vida.rs:1218) and paso_7_pausa_reintenta_una_vez_tras_sin_conexion_y_continua_hasta_exito. Both log entries are accurate.

The two 'structurally unreachable' paths: the Ok(_) arm after transitar(Reemparejando) from Aprovisionada/Retirada is unreachable per transiciones_permitidas (Aprovisionada -> EnEjecucion|Retirada; Retirada terminal) and is now a diagnosed Fallo, not a panic; the former Ok(Fallido) arm no longer exists because the narrowed return type cannot express it (verified by compilation).

Step 10 vs D5: reanudar fallido -> Fallo with the diagnostic carrying the motivo, no confirmar_reemparejamiento call, row stays Reemparejando, no sustituciones row (comandos.rs step 10 then confirmar in one transaction); Exito is never reported with the sidecar left paused. canal_sin_sesion on reanudar counts as success, as on pausar.

No panic path reintroduced: the only unreachable!() in the crate is comandos.rs:72 (pre-existing since ba447545, ConfigRender/ReporteTokens dispatch, untouched by this task); no unwrap/expect/panic!/process::exit/println!/eprintln! in hexcell-admin src; no TcpStream, sidecar.sock, HEXCELL_SOCKET_IPC, 8082 or docker exec in the crate.

No test sleeps real seconds: reemparejamiento.rs and ciclo_de_vida.rs use cadencia 1 ms; the 1.5 s wall time of the reemparejamiento binary is 6 x MARGEN_DE_SILENCIO (750 ms recv_timeout in exigir_silencio), not sleeps; no production constant (por_omision, LIMITE_*) imported by tests.

Minor, non-blocking: tests/comandos.rs:13 imports MOTIVO_DE_ALTA_IMPLICITA that the replaced test no longer uses (warning under cargo test; CI clippy passes because it runs without --all-targets); ciclo_de_vida.rs:1080 assertion message says 'cuarta sonda / tercer intento' for a two-attempt scenario; reemparejamiento.rs ejecutar_rebind keeps an unused inventario parameter (let _ = inventario); reemparejamiento.rs:34 IMAGEN_DEL_ACCESORIO equals the production default alpine:3 (ciclo_de_vida.rs uses sonda-de-prueba:1, which does discriminate).

Design observation for the parent HEX-085 (not a defect of this child, D5 as specified): after a step-10 reanudar fallido the row stays Reemparejando while the session is already paired; a later cell rebind resumes at step 8 and requests a new pairing, which D2 answers ya_emparejada -> Fallo. The recovery path for that state is not defined in this child.
Spanish throughout; fix commit is a conventional commit with no AI attribution; tests/comun/mod.rs unmodified; no Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock change.
